race.comment: ALL BANGED UP (2) finished third as favourite last time out over 1400m at Rockhampton, making it three minor placings from four career starts. Where there's smoke there's fire and he is a definite leading hope from the favourable draw. LADY BARBAROSSA (12) has switched yards since finishing eighth three-and-a-half weeks ago over 1400m at Sunshine Coast. Rates highly against this company and expected to go well. BESTOV (11) is on an eight-day back-up after finishing in the money over 1300m at Mackay. Strong run last time and shapes as a major threat. OVERLAND (5) progressed nicely last start to finish a close third over 1200m at Townsville after missing the placings at the previous appearance. This looks a good race for him and he is one of the key runners.
